Messages.Author: Mark Allen
Messages.Body:
I was wondering if there is a criteria that determined what cards are
stackable and those that are not. Is there s list somewhere on the net?
Maybe there is a rule that makes it easy to remember. HELP

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Easy rule: All effects are stackable inasfar as allowed by card text.

Some types of cards have special limitations on playing the card in
the first place:

1) A single minion cannot play more than one of the same action
modifier (by card name) per action.

2) A single minion cannot play more than one of the same reaction (by
card name) per action.

3) A single minion cannot use more than 1 additional-strike-gaining
effect per round of combat.
